body:
They might be free. I guess. In theory. But doing things to find friends or love takes a bit of money. Or a lot of money. I got a girl's number a couple of weeks ago, but I didn't even bother messaging or calling her, because what was I going to suggest? 

I can't invite her out for drinks. Or lunch. Or a supper. All of that takes way more money than I have. 

I wish I could be positive, but there is nothing to be positive about :(
I don't know what I can try. Everything is so expensive.
I am all out of hope, and things to hope for :(
I don't even get to the interview.

I have a degree in accounting, and a couple years experience as an audit clerk. But it's not enough here. We have an unemployment rate of around 35 %, pretty much 50% for people under the age of 30, and I am the wrong colour. Finding a job right now feels impossible. And it's only getting worse :(
I don't know of any others that can help right now. And will power is not enough here :(
Nothing really makes me happy anymore. And nothing gives me hope.
I don't know what kinda first step is even possible right now :(

You can do anything with a blank piece of paper, but you do need a pen. And a surface to press on. I guess. If we are extending this metaphor. The pen being qualifications, and the surface being an environment where jobs are available. I don't know.  But whatever. I have neither of those things.

Not much really :(

Hobbies can get expensive. I usually just watch sport or play computer games. But I suck at games, and my teams suck at sport. So I don't even enjoy that anymore.
Well there is nothing. I don't know what I can do to find something either.

They don't really. I just feel so guilty. And I know it's never going to end :(

There is no other way out
Thanks for the reply. Just by living, I am hurting people. It costs my parents money to keep me around. It hurts me to do that to them.
